name: Lenahra
description: Lenahra was a terrestrial planet on the most distant reaches of the Outer Rim Territories in the Unknown Regions. The planet was strong with life energy and had a degree of sentience, with its entire biosphere strongly connected to each other through a substance known as the Power.
lead_paragraphs: Lenahra was a terrestrial planet on the most distant reaches of the Outer Rim Territories in the Unknown Regions.
